description_en: Queries the list of asynchronous tasks by calling ListTasks
description_zh: 调用ListTasks查询异步任务列表
name: ListTasks

parameters.help_en: The access configuration ID used as a filter condition
parameters.help_zh: 访问配置ID，用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The task target type used as a filter condition.

Valid values: RD-Account, which indicates that the task target type is an account in a resource directory.

You must specify both `TargetId` and `TargetType` for the filter condition to take effect
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标类型，用于查询的过滤条件。

取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号。

`TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The task target ID used as a filter condition.

You must specify both `TargetId` and `TargetType` for the filter condition to take effect
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标ID，用于查询的过滤条件。

`TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The CloudSSO identity type used as a filter condition. Valid values:

User: user.
Group: group.

You must specify both `PrincipalId` and `PrincipalType` for the filter condition to take effect
parameters.help_zh:
云SSO身份类型，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

User：用户。
Group：用户组。

`PrincipalId`与`PrincipalType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en:
The CloudSSO identity ID used as a filter condition. Details:

If `PrincipalType` is `User`, `PrincipalId` is the CloudSSO user ID.
If `PrincipalType` is `Group`, `PrincipalId` is the CloudSSO group ID.

You must specify both `PrincipalId` and `PrincipalType` for the filter condition to take effect
parameters.help_zh:
云SSO身份ID，用于查询的过滤条件。具体如下：

当`PrincipalType`为`User`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户ID。
当`PrincipalType`为`Group`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户组ID。

`PrincipalId`与`PrincipalType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: principal_id

parameters.help_en:
The node type used as a filter condition. Valid values:

ProvisionAccessConfiguration: access configuration provisioning deployment.
DeprovisionAccessConfiguration: remove access configuration provisioning.
CreateAccessAssignment: grant authorization on an account in a resource directory.
DeleteAccessAssignment: remove authorization from an account in a resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

ProvisionAccessConfiguration：部署访问配置。
DeprovisionAccessConfiguration：解除访问配置部署。
CreateAccessAssignment：在RD账号上授权。
DeleteAccessAssignment：移除RD账号上的授权
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The task status used as a filter condition. Valid values:

InProgress: the task is in progress.
Success: the task succeeded.
Failed: the task failed
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

InProgress：任务执行中。
Success：任务执行成功。
Failed：任务执行失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify `NextToken` for the first invoke.

If the total number of results exceeds the value of `MaxResults` on the first invoke, the results are truncated. Only `MaxResults` results are returned, `IsTruncated` is set to `true`, and a `NextToken` is returned. Use the `NextToken` from the previous response to invoke the method again, keeping all other request parameters unchanged, to retrieve the truncated results. Repeat this process until `IsTruncated` is `false`, which indicates that all results have been retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。首次调用API不需要`NextToken`。

当您首次调用API时，如果返回数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，数据会被截断，只返回`MaxResults`条数据，同时，返回参数`IsTruncated`为`true`，返回一个`NextToken`。您可以使用上一次返回的`NextToken`继续调用API，其他请求参数保持不变，查询被截断的数据。您可以按此方法多次查询，直到`IsTruncated`为`false`，表示全部数据查询完毕
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of results per page.

Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~20。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition.

Format: `<Attribute> <Operator> <Value>`, case-insensitive. `<Attribute>` supports only StartTime. `<Operator>` supports only ge (greater than or equals). `<Value>` must be in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:SSZ and must be within the last 7 days.

Example: `Filter = "StartTime ge 2021-03-15T01:12:23Z"` queries tasks starting from 2021-03-15T01:12:23 GMT (UTC+0).

If this parameter is not specified, the API returns tasks created within the last 24 hours by default
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件。

格式：<Attribute> <Operator> <Value>，不区分大小写。其中，<Attribute>只支持StartTime，<Operator>只支持ge（Greater Than or Equals），<Value>格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:SSZ，且只能填写距离当前时间不超过7天的值。

示例：Filter = "StartTime ge 2021-03-15T01:12:23Z"，表示查询从2021-03-15T01:12:23 GMT（0时区）时间开始的任务列表。

如不指定该参数，则默认返回距离当前时间24小时内的任务列表
parameters.name: filter

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the results are truncated. Valid values:

true: The results are truncated.
false: The results are not truncated
IsTruncated.description_zh:
返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true：已截断。
false：未截断

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results per page

NextToken.description_en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results.

This parameter is returned only when `IsTruncated` is `true`
NextToken.description_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。

只有`IsTruncated`为`true`，才显示该参数

EndTime.description_en: The time when the task ended
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

FailureReason.description_en:
The reason why the task failed.

This parameter is returned only when `Status` is `Failed`
FailureReason.description_zh:
任务失败原因。

只有`Status`为`Failed`，才显示该参数
